book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Juda bɛɛŋ ki wu gêsɛ Jiso
Kife ki Ŋka wu Blɛd wù ba baaŋ kinshilɛ yo gɛɛ gɛ, wù ba tɛŋe lɛ Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe, gɛ̀ bee wu too wa mbebe le.
Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo, bo gɛ̀ goone je yì bo yuuyɛ Jiso nyu nyilɛ le, nje bo gɛ̀ faane bamii.
Sataŋ lee a fitele fì Juda wù ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Ɛkaliot le, nyu muh wu ŋgoo yi booŋ ba Jiso ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ.
Wu ja wu gɛɛŋ fɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ le, bɛ bikwɛɛ bi nchi bì gɛ̀ chiɛɛne yeh yi kintanyɛ. Bɛ bo mo bo seesɛ no wu lé wu gê fɛ wu gêsɛ Jiso bo le.
Bo yu njoŋ bo mo bo bɛɛŋ ki bo laŋɛ wu bɛ bige.
Wu bɛɛŋ, wu mo wu gɛɛŋ wu kɛ wu goone je yì wu lé wu nyâ Jiso chiaaŋ yiboo le, sege bamii ba duude ya fo gɛ.
Nseesɛ wu Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe
Juu chi Ŋka wu Blɛd wù ba baaŋ Kinshilɛ yo gɛɛ gɛ, chi ba lé ba sɛ̂ɛ mwa kiya wu Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe wɛɛ gɛ̀ to chi kojɛ,
Jiso mo wu tuŋ Bita bɛ Joŋ wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ sêesɛ mwɛɛ mù bee lé be gê be jî Ŋka wunɛ yu.”

content: Bo biih wu le lɛ, “Wo goone lɛ bee gɛɛŋ be seesɛ nyu faane?”
Wu chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yû, sege bɛŋ lese bɛŋ gɛɛne alaantɛŋ, bɛŋ lé bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ muh mu le wu tuu joo a shaaŋ le, bɛŋ bî wu le, yeh yì wu gɛɛŋ wu lee yu.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ bi, bɛŋ jɛ̂mɛ chiji yeh yɛɛ le lɛ Muh wu N'yɛyɛ biide laa kibuu ki bamii ba njiɛnyɛ kɛɛ kì bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le bo ji Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe yu le faane la?
Wu mo wu dunyɛ kibuu ki yeh ki awe, ba nyu ba seesɛ wa ba kɛnyɛ, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ sêesɛ mwɛɛ munjile yu.”
Noo, bo gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ mwɛɛ gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Jiso gɛ̀ jɛmɛ bo le. Bo mo bo seesɛ mwɛɛ munjile mu Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe wuyu fo.

content: Jiso bɛ booŋ be gɛ̀ ji ntɛ wu Tada Jiso
Lɛ kife to ki kojɛ, Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ntuŋ to bo shii bo jii mwɛɛ.
Wu ja wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nchi ŋkoŋe lo baaŋ ki nji Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe wunɛ bɛ bɛŋ fɛ ŋge yɛŋ ŋgɛ wù too le.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ gɛ mbaaŋ ŋka ŋge nji ŋka wunɛ gɛ, gɛɛne bude no fi lé fi gê fi tô fi kôjɛ sege Nyo lé wu gê wu sâge bvunfoŋ bwe.”

content: Wu jo fiŋkoo, wu nya kiyone Nyo le wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kô bɛŋ mù bɛŋ bachii bɛŋ kɛnɛ.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ, kɛge mɛɛse gɛɛne, gɛ mbaaŋ ŋka mu mbvuuŋ ma nchwɛŋ wu kite ki laane manɛ gɛ, gɛɛne bude sege bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo lé bvu gê bvu tô”

content: Wu jo blɛd, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu bwɛɛyɛ wu nya bo le wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Finɛ le ye yaŋ yi nnya nje bɛŋ. Bɛŋ gêe finɛ noo ki bɛŋ kwâji mɛ.”

content: Gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bo mɛɛse mwɛɛ munjile, wu jo fiŋkoo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Fiŋkoo finɛ le maŋkaŋ ma manfɛŋ ma Nyo gwo bɛ kilɛmɛ kaŋ ki bu nje bɛŋ.
Geenɛ, bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû! Muh wù lé wu gêsɛ mɛ jii mwɛɛ fɛnɛ besa wu.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gɛ̂ɛŋ gɛh no Nyo gɛ̀ seesɛ. Geenɛ, ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le fɛ muh wù lé wu gêsɛ wu le.”

content: Bo mo bo kɛ bo biide ye yi biboo le laa muh wù taŋlo wu ge noo a bo ntɛnɛɛ le yɛɛŋ.
Jiso yɛyɛ no bamii be kɛme ki bo jôde bikwɛɛ biboo
Bo gɛ̀ ja bo kɛ kintɛɛnyɛ lɛbolɛbo laa bo le nɛ muh wù baaŋ a bo ntɛnɛɛ le yɛɛŋ?
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Banfoŋ ba bituŋ kɛme bvuŋga a bamii baboo we, bamii ba sage woŋ bo duu lɛ ba tɛ̂ŋe bo lɛ bitooŋ bi bamii.
Geenɛ, gɛ taŋlo fi nyûme noo bɛ bɛŋ gɛ. Muh wù baaŋ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ jôde lɛ wu le mwa wù shige, muh wu le kikwɛɛ le njɛ muh wù lɛne bɛŋ le bachii.
Muh wù baaŋ le wù la, muh wù yɛmɛ wu jii lo nji le noo, muh wù dɛɛde le? Gɛ nyu muh wù yɛmɛ wu jii lo gɛ? Geenɛ nle a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ njɛ muh wù lɛne bɛŋ le.
No nshee n'yɛde baŋgɛ segechii, le gɛh bɛŋ banɛ ba to ba nyume besabɛŋ.
Fi mo fi nyu lɛ, gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Chii le wu nya mɛ bvunfoŋ lɛ nsâge, nnya tɛ bɛŋ bvuŋga lɛ bɛŋ sâge.
Nnya wu lɛ besabɛŋ ge be jii mwɛɛ, be muu mwɛɛ kijusɛ kimimia a nto waŋ le, bɛŋ shiiyɛ yi bakala le, bɛŋ sage chikfuu chi Ishwala chi yuufe ncho chifɛɛ.”

content: Jiso sɛɛŋ no Bita lé wu gê wu fâŋ wu

content.text: Jiso mo wu ja wu tɛɛŋ Bita lɛ, “Samoŋ, Samoŋ yegɛ yu wo kêe lɛ Sataŋ le wu fi bvuŋga ki wu chɛ̂gɛ bɛŋ bachii wu bvusɛ bamu gɛh njɛ no muh to wu fɛɛde agiŋ wu bvusɛ munyi.
Geenɛ nle mbuunɛ fɛ wo le, lɛ keefɛ fitele fiuŋ mo fi bu lo yi ye yaŋ le gɛ. Sege wo kaasɛ wo tɛɛŋ bvufee bwuŋ jiŋ, wo nya bvuŋga booŋ ba bwoo le.”

content: Bita du lɛ, “Tada, mo nyu ki ŋgɛɛŋ ncha, no nyu kɛnɛ ki ŋkwe lo, tu nle gɛh besa wo.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Bita, yû nsɛŋe wo le, nyishii lé yi gê yi tôŋ abɛŋ, wo nyu wo faŋ wa mɛ kiŋgane kintɛde, lɛ gɛ wo kee mɛ gɛ.”

content: Jiso tefɛ no booŋ be ba ŋgoo bo seesɛ muntele
Wu ja wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kwaji kife kì ŋgɛ ntuŋ bɛŋ bige sɛŋ, kikɛɛ sɛŋ, jé sɛŋ, no bɛŋ gɛ̀ gɛnɛ bɛŋ jiɛnyi, bɛŋ gɛ̀ bee bɛŋ fu fiɛɛ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Ayɛɛ, bee gɛ̀ baaŋ fiɛɛ fu gɛ.”
Wu mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Yi mɛɛse le, muh nɛ kɛme bige, mo nyu kikɛɛ, wu jo. Muh nɛ kɛme gɛ nyo yi jɛŋ gɛ, wu gesɛ kikuŋ ke wu gu nyo yu.
Njɛme finɛ nje fiɛɛ fì ba gɛ̀ saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ,
‘Ba gɛ̀ taŋ wu bɛ bamii ba befe’,
fi kɛme ki fi kooshɛ bɛ mɛ mɛɛse. Bɛŋ kêe lɛ mwɛɛ mù ba gɛ̀ saŋ kune mɛ lé mu tôo wa ki mu kôjɛ munchii.”

content: Bo mo bo jaŋɛ lɛ, “Tada, bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ bee kɛme nyó yi jɛŋ yifiɛɛ.” Wu chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ lû noo!”

content: Jiso buunɛ yi mbegɛ wu Bite bi Olif le
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu bu alaantɛŋ bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo, bo mo bo kɛ bo bɛɛne mbegɛ wu Bite bi Olif, nyu no wu to wù gee.
Bo bɛɛŋ bo bu fɛ bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne fo, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ bûune lɛ keefɛ moŋ to fɛ bɛŋ le, wu ya bɛŋ gɛ.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu kɛŋsɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu bu fɛ taŋlo muh noŋ tɛdɛ chi gɛɛŋ chi bu fo, wu mo wu ŋgvuumɛ fɛkuu wu buunɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Chii, fi nɛ le fi kojɛ fɛ wo le, wo chiaasɛ fiŋkoo fi ŋgɛ finɛ lɛ keefɛ mmu gɛ. Geenɛ gêe gɛh no wo koŋe, keefɛ wo gê no ŋkoŋe gɛ.”

content: No wu buunɛ noo, nchɛndaa Nyo shii we wu to fɛ wu le, wu nya wu bvuŋga.
Jiso nyu fitele fie suume wu baaŋ nɛ wɛɛmm wɛɛmm. Wu buunɛ lo chi shaŋ chiɛɛ, mbunyɛ chiɛɛnyi yi nshɛŋ le njɛ bitɛde bi kilɛmɛ.]
Wu buunɛ wu mɛsɛ, wu tu jiŋ fɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le, wu yɛŋ lefɛ ge wa bo fwɛɛŋ bo tu bo lefe.
Wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ ka lefe lo? Bɛŋ jâ we bɛŋ bûune fɛ moŋ ge wu to fɛ bɛŋ le, wu ya bɛŋ gɛ.”

content: Bamii ba woŋ koo Jiso
Gɛh no wu gɛ̀ baaŋ wu jɛme, kinchvu ki bamii bunɛ bo tu bo too, nyume gɛh Juda wù gɛ̀ bee muh wu ŋgoo yi booŋ ba Jiso ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ le, wu gɛ̀ too bo fwe. Wu to mbebe Jiso le wu ŋkfugɛ wu.
Geenɛ, Jiso biih Juda le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo nɛ goone ki wo kfûgɛ Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh nɛ ki wo dûnyɛ lɛ ba koo wu?”

content: Booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba gɛ̀ bee mbebe ye le yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ kooshi le, bo biih lɛ, “Tada, bee gwôojɛ bamii banɛ?”
Muh mu bo le gɛ̀ goone ki wu gwô, wu mo wu chuŋ nyu kintuŋ kinchiɛɛŋ ki fwa wu kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ.
Jiso kaŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ muh ka wu môŋ gɛ!”

content: Wu mo wu kuŋ kintuŋ ki muh wuyu le ki mo ki kâasɛ ki tu fo.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ too ki bo koo Jiso gɛ̀ bee bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bikwɛɛ bi nchi bì gɛ̀ chiɛɛne yeh yi kintanyɛ mo bamii ba gɛ̀ sage woŋ. Wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ to ki bɛŋ kôo mɛ, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ too bɛ nyó yi jɛŋ mo bimbuge njɛ bɛŋ too ki bɛŋ kôo nyume choŋ?
Nchi nshee lɛ juu lɛ juu mo fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, fɛ bɛŋ koo mɛ sɛŋ nje la? Geenɛ, mɛɛse le kife kena ki taŋlo bɛŋ ge fiɛɛ, nyume kife ki bvuŋga bvu ki kijibɛ.”

content: Bita faŋ Jiso
Bamii bayu mo bo koo Jiso bo gɛɛne bɛ wu fɛ la chi kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ le, Bita bii ajiŋ je yì ndefe le.
Bo gɛɛŋ bo fwɛɛ ŋgu lakfulɛ fɛ ntɛnɛɛ, lɛ bo shii bo yɛse. Bita mo wu to wu shii bɛ bo.
No ŋgu kwɛɛ gɛ̀ bɛde noo, mwa wù kwɛse wumu wù gɛ̀ lɛne fɛ la chiyu le ja wu yɛŋ Bita le no wu shii. Wu bijɛ wu nɛ tuŋŋ wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Muh wunɛ be bee bɛ muh wege.”
Bita mo wu kajɛ lo ye, wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Kwɛse wunɛ, gɛ ŋkee wu gɛ.”
Kife doo ki kɛŋsɛ gɛ nɛ shige, muh mu ka wu yɛŋ wu le, wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Wo tɛ le muh ŋgoo yiboo le.” Geenɛ Bita jɛmɛ lɛ, “Jwɛŋsɛ, gɛ mɛ nyume muh mu a bo ntɛnɛɛ gɛ.”
Kife gɛɛŋ ki bu njɛ ntaŋ wu kife kimimia, muh mu ka wu taŋ lɛ, “Nchiɛɛŋ, muh wunɛ be bee bɛ wu, nje wu le tɛ muh wu Galalee.”
Bita mo wu faŋ wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Jwɛŋsɛ wunɛ, gɛ ŋkee fiɛɛ fì wo jɛme gɛ.” Gɛ no wu gɛh baaŋ wu jɛme, kimimia nyishii mo yi toŋ.
Tada kaasɛ ye ajii a we tasɛ bɛ a Bita. Bita kwajɛ njɛmɛ wù Tada be jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nyishii lé yi tôŋ abɛŋ, wo nyu wo faŋ wa mɛ kiŋgane kintɛde.”

content: Wu ja fo wu bu akfuuŋ, wu bee kwe baaŋ.
Bo buu Jiso bo ka suŋe wu
Bamii ba gɛ jiji Jiso le bo mo bo kɛ bo buu wu, bo suŋe wu,
bo baŋe bvushi bwe bɛ nju, bo duu wu le lɛ, “Gɛ gee la muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo kuŋ. Gɛh sɛɛŋ muh wu suŋ wo.”
Bo ka bo baade lo wu bɛ bachuŋ wesee.
Bo sa nsa wu Jiso

Akfuuŋ gɛ̀ doo a yuude a too, bamii ba sage woŋ bɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ mo bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo banyɛ ye bachii. No bo banyi noo, bo mo bo jo Jiso bo gɛɛŋ bɛ wu fɛ bo gɛ̀ sage bansa fo.
No bo gɛnɛ bɛ wu noo, bo biih wu le lɛ, “Nɛ le wo wu le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka, wo sɛ̂ɛŋ bee le?” Wu chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe lo bɛŋ le, bɛŋ gɛ bɛɛŋ gɛ.
Mbiide fiɛɛ bɛŋ le, bɛŋ gɛ chvuu gɛ.
Geenɛ, kɛge yi mɛɛse le, muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gê wu shîi a kibo kinchiɛɛŋ ki Nyo wu bvuŋga le.”

content: Bo mo bo jaŋɛ bo bachii lɛ, “Fi nɛ le lɛ, le wo wu le Mwa Nyo?” Wu chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Fi le no bɛŋ jɛme.”

content: Bo mo bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Taŋlo bo ka bo goone lo muh mu ki wu sɛ̂ɛŋ lɛ la? Bee le be yu wa fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme bɛ jwe we.”

footnotes.text: Gɛ baŋwa ba kege bamu ba bo gɛ̀ ya saŋ jɛ yi Nyo yo kɛme binchiŋ binɛ gɛ 43-44.
